title: No One Left
read_query: SELECT text FROM poem_surface ORDER BY slot
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE housing_unit(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), persons_living_in_unit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(persons_living_in_unit IN (0,1)), every_occupant_usual_residence_elsewhere INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(every_occupant_usual_residence_elsewhere IN (0,1)), vacancy_status TEXT GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN persons_living_in_unit = 0 THEN 'VACANT' WHEN every_occupant_usual_residence_elsewhere = 1 THEN 'VACANT' ELSE 'OCCUPIED' END) VIRTUAL) STRICT
CREATE TABLE departures(event_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, unit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES housing_unit(singleton), note TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TABLE classification_change(singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1), old_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(old_status IN ('OCCUPIED','VACANT')), new_status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(new_status IN ('OCCUPIED','VACANT')), changed_field TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TRIGGER record_classification_change AFTER UPDATE OF every_occupant_usual_residence_elsewhere ON housing_unit WHEN OLD.vacancy_status <> NEW.vacancy_status BEGIN INSERT INTO classification_change(singleton,old_status,new_status,changed_field) VALUES (1,OLD.vacancy_status,NEW.vacancy_status,'EVERY OCCUPANT''S USUAL RESIDENCE'); END

CREATE VIEW poem_surface(slot,text) AS SELECT 10,'HOUSING UNIT' UNION ALL SELECT 20,'' UNION ALL SELECT 30,'PERSONS LIVING IN UNIT | ' || CASE WHEN persons_living_in_unit = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END FROM housing_unit UNION ALL SELECT 40,'EVERY OCCUPANT''S USUAL RESIDENCE | ' || CASE WHEN every_occupant_usual_residence_elsewhere = 1 THEN 'ELSEWHERE' ELSE 'HERE' END FROM housing_unit UNION ALL SELECT 50,'DEPARTURES RECORDED | ' || CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM departures) AS TEXT) FROM housing_unit UNION ALL SELECT 60,'' FROM housing_unit UNION ALL SELECT 70,'PRIOR STATUS | ' || old_status FROM classification_change UNION ALL SELECT 80,'CURRENT STATUS | ' || vacancy_status FROM housing_unit
transition_sql: UPDATE housing_unit SET every_occupant_usual_residence_elsewhere = 1 WHERE singleton = 1

transition_summary.derived_field: housing_unit.vacancy_status is a VIRTUAL generated column
transition_summary.rendering: SQL view over housing-unit state, departure count, and trigger log

formal_claim: The base database already records people living in the unit, usual residence here, zero departure rows, and a generated OCCUPIED status. One explicit UPDATE in the WAL changes only the usual-residence field; an AFTER UPDATE trigger records OCCUPIED becoming VACANT. Canonical full-row snapshots cover every user table in primary-key order, and the main database bytes remain unchanged before checkpoint.
non_claim: The source mapping, trigger behavior, canonical every-table state contract, and byte invariants verify formal behavior only; they do not establish literary success, a real housing classification, or reader uptake.
